g.text: OULAD group outcome gaps, with a simple baseline
DESCRIPTIVE, NOT CAUSAL. Each point is (group rate minus complement rate) in 2014J minus the same gap in 2013J. Both models use the same audit
students. Gray crosses mean an insufficient relevant denominator (at least 20 is required in all four group/complement-period cells); they are not
zero effects. The CSV retains every numerator and denominator, including Everyone. TPR/FPR gaps of an all-positive predictor are zero by construction;
